Class KeyTrigger

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tui.bindings.KeyTrigger
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputTrigger
public final class KeyTrigger extends Object implements InputTrigger
An InputTrigger that matches KeyEvents.

Key triggers can match:

  • A specific KeyCode (e.g., UP, ENTER)
  • A character with optional modifiers (e.g., 'k', Ctrl+'u', Super+'k')
// Match the UP arrow key
KeyTrigger.key(KeyCode.UP)

// Match lowercase 'j'
KeyTrigger.ch('j')

// Match 'j' or 'J' (case-insensitive)
KeyTrigger.chIgnoreCase('j')

// Match Ctrl+U
KeyTrigger.ctrl('u')

// Match Alt+V
KeyTrigger.alt('v')

// Match Super+K (Command/Windows)
KeyTrigger.superKey('k')

// Match Shift+Tab
KeyTrigger.key(KeyCode.TAB, false, false, true)

    • matchesKey

      public boolean matchesKey(KeyEvent event)
      Returns true if this trigger matches the given key event.

      Matching rules:

      • Release events are ignored unless explicitly requested with withKind(KeyEventKind)
      • Key code must match (or character matches for character triggers)
      • Ctrl, Alt, Super, Hyper, and Meta modifiers must match exactly
      • Shift is only checked if explicitly required by the trigger
      • For character triggers, matches logical, shifted, base-layout, or produced text
      Parameters:
      event - the key event to match against
      Returns:
      true if this trigger matches the event
